scope: Read-only current source/resource audit. No production edits, builds or game launches. Supplements the complete PNG/block-model inventory.
interpretation_rules: Texture resolution alone is never a non-pixel verdict.
Non-axis polygons, UV atlas remapping and rigid animation are geometry/rendering traits, not proof of smoothed raster pixels.
Per-vertex normal/color interpolation is reported separately from raster texture style.
The 512px LOD atlas is a padded packing sheet, not one512px block face. Its16px cells are independent source tiles.
Historical workspace tools outside Guogaology are provenance clues, not current formal-repository generation entry points.
Counts refer to block registry IDs; JSON level suffixes preserve internal material stages and are not renamed display grades.

lod_atlas.method: For each unique used texture/tint/UV tile, recomputed16x16 BILINEAR resize, rounded32-step average face tint, channel multiplication, and compared every RGBA byte with the actual atlas tile.

animated_portals.note: Interpolation blends adjacent animation frames in time; it is not spatial bilinear filtering. Legacy fruit_portal/guogao_portal model and texture files remain, but the active blockstates select gate_field_0/1/2.
animated_portals.alpha_note: Current sheet includes per-pixel alpha; vanilla translucent layer performs ordinary alpha blending. This changes composited colors, not the authored pixel grid.

native_pixel_exemptions.comment: Native32 pixel curves and quantized two-pixel skin bands; final single1/16-block corner step with30 axis-aligned exterior rectangles and integer model coordinates. This is not a smooth sphere/custom renderer.
Native32 per-pixel trefoil, seven opaque colors, ordinary cube_all. Trigonometric glyph masks are rasterized directly on the pixel grid without supersampling.

Native32 four-color pattern; exterior of six original crossing cuboids,90 orthogonal rectangles. Continuous coordinate UV clipping prevents whole-glyph stretching; it does not interpolate pixel colors.

contextual_overlays.condition: Underworld, tracked nearby connected lamp beat, within84blocks.
contextual_overlays.note: The registered lamp raster remains unchanged. Renderer draws a floating-color film over visible faces.

contextual_overlays.condition: While a valid Laver table is played; note coordinate pulse lasts12ticks, including silent cells.
contextual_overlays.note: This is contextual runtime geometry/color, not generated or uploaded replacement texture pixels.

not_registered_block_effects.name: LHO mirages
not_registered_block_effects.note: Procedural translucent quads are staged in air and drift; do not tag every L/H/O/fffZ/FOS block as dynamic-textured.

runtime_bitmap_generation_search.conclusion: No project runtime bitmap-generation/upload path found in these client source roots. Core renderer transforms cached mesh parts; portals use vanilla sprite-sheet animation.

dense_gradient_texture_case.style: Mixed: hard pixel feature outlines over dense continuous cool-blue to gold shading. Direct native PNG visual inspection confirms the gradient; not inferred merely from128px size.
dense_gradient_texture_case.provenance_caution: These two historical tools live outside formal Guogaology, still target googology, and were not executed. Current mesh/PNG hashes and mappings are the authoritative evidence.

vanilla_block_entity_rendering.target: Minecraft26.2 verified from local cached client jar; do not assume legacy sign rendering is identical.

signs.renderer_conclusion: StandingSignRenderer only extracts attachment/text transformations. Its AbstractSignRenderer.submit emits front/back text through submitSignText/submitText; no board model or wood sign material is submitted. Body is rendered from vanilla template JSON, not an entity/signs atlas.
signs.text_note: Player text is separate native font glyph rendering, so its appearance cannot be summarized by the mod wood PNG resolution. This is not a smooth-raster defect by itself.
